agents.description: Anthropic's official CLI for Claude. Best for complex refactors, architectural changes, and multi-file edits. Use Claude Code when the task requires deep reasoning about code structure.
OpenAI's Codex CLI. Best for quick scripts, API integrations, and OpenAI-ecosystem tasks. Use Codex for rapid prototyping and straightforward coding.
Open-source coding agent. Best for codebase exploration, security audits, and grep-heavy analysis. Use OpenCode when you need to understand unfamiliar code.
Google's Gemini in the terminal. Best for long-context analysis (1M+ tokens), Google Cloud integration, and large-scale refactors. Use Gemini CLI when context size matters.
Moonshot AI's Kimi coding agent. Best for Chinese-language coding tasks, bilingual (CN/EN) codebases, and tasks requiring strong Mandarin language understanding alongside code generation.
